entities.name: (S)-1-Phenylpropan-1-amine
observations: Decoded SELFIES gives CC[C@@H](N)c1ccccc1, a chiral primary amine coupling partner.

entities.name: Aza-bicyclic carboxylic acid

entities.name: Target secondary amide
observations: Decoded product is CC[C@@H](NC(=O)c1ccn2c1CCCC2)c1ccccc1, formed by replacing the acid hydroxyl with the chiral amine nitrogen.

entities.name: Amide coupling: aza-bicyclic acid plus phenylpropan-1-amine

entities.name: EDC.HCl/HOBt in DMF
observations: Exact database precedent uses EDC·HCl and HOBt in DMF at 25 °C for 30 hours; reported yield is 88%.
No additional organic base is explicitly encoded in the exact record.
